title: Bounded decorative lineage tree overview

claims.text: drawTree filters tree.nodes to visibleIds, sorts them with order, and lays out one dot per node at x from generation (capped at 12) and y from sorted index.
drawTree draws a parent line only when the parent point is present and marks the selected node with a larger radius (6 instead of 4).
drawTree returns an SVG marked aria-hidden and focusable false, so relationship evidence must come from the list rather than this overview.

triggers: tree overview shows selected node wrong
parent line missing in tree overview

decision.rule: Change here when the decorative tree overview layout, node positioning, or parent edge rendering needs to change.
decision.failure: Nodes overlap or misorder, parent edges point at the wrong nodes, or the selected node is not emphasized.

questions.q: Where does drawTree compute node positions from generation and sorted index?
Where should I change how drawTree filters trees to visible ids?
Where can I debug why a parent edge is missing in the tree overview?
